questions.q: A mark must be between 0 and 100 inclusive. Which is boundary test data?
questions.why: 100 is on the edge of the valid range; 50 is normal and -50 and abc are erroneous.

questions.q: What is the difference between a function and a procedure?
options: A procedure cannot be called twice
questions.why: Functions send a value back with RETURN; procedures do not.

questions.q: Explain what is meant by validation and state one thing it cannot do.
questions.model: Validation is an automated check that data is reasonable and acceptable to the program, for example a range check. It cannot check that the data is actually correct, e.g. age 21 typed instead of 20 still passes.
